title: Silver vs. Cash: A Tangible Hedge
source: Bureau of Labor Statistics (2024), National Insurance Crime Bureau (2023), World Gold Council (2020)
narration: This chart illustrates the eroding purchasing power of cash due to inflation, highlighted by a 3.1% increase in the Consumer Price Index.  It then compares this to the potential return of investing in silver, showing that $1,000 in cash buys approximately 34.4 ounces of silver based on the current spot price of $29.36 per ounce.  The chart also demonstrates the importance of secure storage, with a significant percentage of burglaries targeting valuable items like jewelry.
